summary: BBVA, a Spanish bank, filed a Form 6-K reporting transactions under the third tranche of its share buyback program. Through July 10, 2026, the program has repurchased shares for €1,042 million, representing 71.39% of the maximum cash amount allocated for this tranche. The buyback is managed by Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG. This is an ordinary open-market repurchase, not a tender offer. The purpose is capital return to shareholders. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The program continues until the maximum amount is reached. Watch for completion of the tranche and any impact on BBVA's capital ratios.
